title: Benchmarking and Mitigating MCQA Selection Bias of Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model prediction distributions on multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) tasks by varying the order of options (e.g., standard ABCD vs. reversed DCBA formats) to detect systematic preferences for specific spatial positions (e.g., favoring the first presented option) regardless of the content.

Analyzing model answer distributions on balanced fine-grained visual MCQA datasets across different option orderings and alternative numeric identifiers (e.g., 1/2/3/4 instead of A/B/C/D) to detect intrinsic preferences for specific option labels (e.g., defaulting to 'A') irrespective of semantic content or structural position.
